rule_set.name: AISC 360-16, Specification for Structural Steel Buildings, allowable strength design

material.name: Shipbuilding steel grade A (normal strength)
material.source: IACS UR W11, normal strength hull structural steel

steps.label: Weight on one bracket
steps.note: k_c allows for the pipe being continuous over several supports, which puts more than one span's weight on some of them.

steps.label: Downward force
steps.note: a_v is the vertical ship-motion acceleration in g, on top of gravity.

steps.label: Force across the pipe
steps.note: The pipe runs fore and aft, so a_h is the athwartships acceleration.

steps.label: Friction along the pipe
steps.note: The support is a sliding guide; the pipe anchors take the axial inertia of the run.

steps.label: Natural frequency of one span
steps.note: Simply supported span: the lowest, safest estimate.

steps.label: Pipe bending between supports
steps.note: q_d is the pipe weight with the vertical and horizontal accelerations combined; S²/10 for a continuous pipe.

steps.label: Longest spacing
steps.formula: smallest of the stress, sag and frequency limits
steps.substituted: stress 12.10 m, sag 4.70 m, frequency 2.35 m
steps.note: The frequency limit keeps f_n 20% above the highest excitation (37.50 Hz).
